Network & Cybersecurity Administrator


infinilink is expanding its team and is looking for a Network & Cybersecurity Administrator to support and secure IT&C infrastructures for our company and clients.

Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain network and IT infrastructure.
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot incidents.
  • Provide technical support to users (remote and on-site).
  • Implement and operate cybersecurity solutions.
  • Collaborate with technical teams on IT and security projects.
  • Work from our offices and client sites in Timișoara and Bucharest.

Requirements

  • Experience in network and IT infrastructure administration.
  • Solid knowledge of networking (LAN/WAN, routing, switching).
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Basic to intermediate cybersecurity knowledge.
  • CCNA certification and/or Palo Alto / Fortinet firewall certifications are a strong advantage.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Why infinilink

  • Hands-on projects in infrastructure and cybersecurity.
  • Dynamic and professional technical environment.
  • Continuous training and career development.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you are passionate about IT infrastructure and cybersecurity and want to work on meaningful projects, we would be happy to meet you.
